H.5008, 'An Act authorizing local voting rights for permanent legal residents residing in Brookline', a joint petition of Rep. Vitolo and Sen. Creem; referred to the Joint Committee on Election Laws on 7/11/2022, with no further action on 1/3/2023. It concerns whether non-citizen permanent residents may vote in local elections, which is related to citizenship requirements to vote.
